name: Yang Shangkun
contribution: A Chinese Communist military and political leader, president of China from 1988 to 1993, and one of the Eight Elders that dominated the party after the death of Mao Zedong.
legacy: Along with Xi Zhongxun, he persuaded Deng Xiaoping that Guangdong should become a national demonstration zone for reform and opening up.

checks.lead: Yang Shangkun (3 August 1907 – 14 September 1998) was a Chinese Communist military and political leader, president of China from 1988 to 1993, and one of the Eight Elders that dominated the party after the death of Mao Zedong.
